translations.answer: Do not mix methods from different levels: the contributor states that get_measured_joint_efforts belongs to the Isaac Sim high-level Articulation class, while root_physx_view exposes a physics tensor API. The lower level can read get_link_incoming_joint_force, which is a 6D incoming wrench per DOF; the questioner believes they need get_dof_projected_joint_forces and get_dof_actuation_forces, but no testing has been completed. These names can be used as diagnostic points, but they cannot be considered as verified external force isolation solutions.
translations.applicability: Applies to distinguishing the Isaac Sim high-level Articulation API from the IsaacLab root_physx_view physics tensor API; specific methods may vary by version.
translations.credibility.rationale: No reproducible records have been formed.
translations.details.attempts.0: The contributor suggests using get_link_incoming_joint_force; the questioner further finds get_dof_projected_joint_forces and get_dof_actuation_forces.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: First distinguish the Isaac Sim high-level Articulation API from the lower-level physics tensor ArticulationView API; then clarify whether the required forces are 6D incoming wrenches, DOF projected external forces, or actuation forces.
translations.details.environments.0: IsaacLab Articulation/root_physx_view; specific Isaac Lab/Sim versions and robots are not mentioned.
translations.details.limits.0: The original thread did not verify whether get_dof_projected_joint_forces equals the target external force, nor did it clearly state whether each item includes constraint reaction forces, driving forces, or sign conventions.
translations.details.outcomes.0: The API level error is confirmed; the questioner believes DOF projected/actuation forces may be used, but no testing has been completed.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Why is root_physx_view missing get_measured_joint_efforts, and how can we obtain the external joint force along DOF direction?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Before using these APIs for actuator protection or contact detection, verify the projected external force and driving force separately with known loads.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The lower-level root_physx_view called a method only belonging to the Isaac Sim high-level Articulation class.
translations.source.title: get_measured_joint_efforts belongs to the high-level Articulation API, and is not present in root_physx_view.
